document_title: DFS 504 Gateway Timeout Failure SOP
source_path: resources\eDelivery SOP\DDL Gateway Timeout SOP- Rev 1.docx
summary: When CSL calls Flexera for Create Entitlement or Create Line Item and it takes >180 s, the APIGEE gateway (180 s timeout) returns '504 Server Error: Gateway Timeout' to Fabric even though FNO completes; Fabric retries create duplicate entitlements/subscription activations in DFS and MDH. Two Pulse ticket scenarios: Create Entitlement failure (DFS API Create Entitlement) and Upgrade Entitlement failure (DFS API Create Line Item); ticket gives payload, order type, DFS API, failure timestamp, order number, error message. Risk: Low. Prereqs: GitLab access + VScan CLI, COF, ALM. Troubleshoot: run VscanCli, choose option 1/2, enter Order ID and time in UTC; logs in VScanCli.txt, output vscan_output_<timestamp>.json. No data → tell IT FABRIC DFS has no data and they must retry manually. Resolve: take entitlement ID + activation IDs from JSON, share with MDH; MDH returns DFS notification per activation ID; DFS maps entitlement ID to each and posts in the Pulse ticket to IT FABRIC; close after FABRIC confirms. Setup: download vscancli repo from GitLab, edit dist/VscanCliconfig.json (client_id, client_secret, base_url, path) per env dev/qa/alpha/stage/prod. POCs: FABRIC – Suma N, Nitesh Gopalani; MDH – Craig Goodenough, Steve Knezic.

document_title: RSVP – Flexera Integration: Software Updates/Downloads Troubleshooting
source_path: resources\eDelivery SOP\RSVP updates_SWD TB SOP.docx
summary: Troubleshoot RSVP device software updates/downloads through Flexera. Use Swagger UI (gehealthcare-ns / gehcstaging-ns /uai) with a Bearer token: POST updatesRequest (deviceClass CLIENT, id, idType STRING, platform, updateFromPkgId) → polling ID → GET updates; POST manifestRequest (uuid) → polling ID → GET download URLs. Bruno collections exist for CSL getPackage/getUpdates. 'Device not registered in FNO' → check device in the right environment. 'Device not entitled' → user checks contract dates with RSVP team; if valid, create entitlement and map. Curl error → internal device: network team steps; customer: whitelist gehealthcare-ns.flexnetoperations.com and download.flexnetoperations.com. DEVICE_NOT_REGISTERED_IN_FLEXERA: wrong FNO endpoint in RSVP; standalone device ID type not STRING (obsolete & recreate; AW LLS PUBLISHER_DEFINED allowed); MongoDB device sync (resave device, wait 30–60 min); CRM number ≠ device ID (check Insite logs, recreate). UPDATES_NOT_FOUND: no Update ID (create, start date in past, wait 1 h); package not synced (RSVP Packages API, resave, else CSL eng); device already on latest version. NO_LINKED_PACKAGE_FOUND: run CSL getPackage for fromPackage, resave and wait 1 h. NO_PRODUCTS: run CSL getProduct, update product and wait 10 min.
notes: SECURITY: source document contains bearer tokens for Stage/Prod; they are intentionally not reproduced here. Recommend removing them from the SOP and revoking them.

error_codes_alerts: We are unable to grant your request because our export control system has identified your request as a potentially non-compliant export
summary: Flexera blocks downloads it flags as potential non-compliant exports (BIS rules); user sees 'We are unable to grant your request because our export control system has identified your request as a potentially non-compliant export…', Flexera auto-creates a case and emails flexeraexportcontrolscreening@gehealthcare.com; users may also raise an incident. Check the user on OFAC sanctions search and trade.gov Consolidated Screening List. Resolution: 1) ask the user's manager to confirm the user is not the denied party (share identifying details from official sources); 2) if account matches ABRL, consult ITC SMEs Ron Tearney and Nancy Boughton; 3) once cleared, submit Flexera's bypass form. Prior correspondence is kept in a Box folder. Do not share/request FNO user personal data. Risk: not applicable.

document_title: Steps to Link Activation PDF to Entitlement
source_file_name: Steps to link Activation PDF to Entitlement (1).docx
source_path: resources\eDelivery SOP\Training\Steps to link Activation PDF to Entitlement (1).docx
summary: Attach an activation (license) PDF to an entitlement in FNO: entitlement must be Deployed (not Draft) and line item type NF; if both Activation IDs share a product use either. Find entitlement (Entitlements > List Entitlement by order), select line item > Activate > Next > Add New Host (serial number = host name) > fulfill count 1 > Generate > Complete and copy Fulfillment ID. In Licenses > Licenses search the Activation/Fulfillment ID (on Hold), Set License, tick 'Preserve Uploaded File name', choose Binary and attach the PDF; Hold becomes NF; verify via Save to File. Normal integration: creates entitlement, fulfillment and attached PDF in Draft; GLPROD ship-confirm deploys it and sends the email.
